title: Application Security knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Application Security”?
options: Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Application Security should reduce unnecessary access and make connections and privileged actions reviewable. Use least-privilege roles, protected secrets, encrypted transport where configured, and a deployment-specific security checklist.
